name: Innovation Residual
formula: h_next = h + F(norm(h)) - beta * (W h + b)

gradient_contract.ntp: W and b detached, h live
gradient_contract.local: mean MSE per branch; h and residual detached; sum across branches

predictors.initialization: 0.001 I, zero bias; no RNG consumption; full rank at initialization only
predictors.optimizer: AdamW within existing combined optimizer, local MSE gradients only

training.data: existing packed FineWeb-Edu 10B, same dev/test and token order
training.outer_optimizer: unchanged MuonAdamW and default LR schedule

diagnostics.profiles: baseline/innovation twice in reversed order, each 20 warmup + 30 measured full training steps
diagnostics.resume: 25 -> exit85 -> fresh process to 50, horizon remains305176
diagnostics.r_squared: variance-weighted 1-SSE/SST, feature-wise centering over same full dev set; undefined zero SST
diagnostics.evaluation: every250steps plus50 and end; all16 branches, beta, MSE, raw/predicted/innovation relative norms

interpretation: Online MSE predictor need not reach the least-squares solution.
Linear unpredictability does not imply task usefulness or functional novelty.
NTP can compensate for the subtraction; this is not a capacity increase.
One seed and one predictor learning rate; no claim of optimal hyperparameters.

operations.checkpoint: latest500 overwrite, best separate, exit85 every1800seconds
operations.monitor: publish after GPU gate, submit one10B, stop at first finite NTP step
